card.name: Third digit of 1800s years
card.fires_on: The third digit of a four-digit year starting 18, such as the 2 in 1824 or the 5 in 1855. It appears mostly in birth and death dates of historical figures.

modes.label: Death or birth dates
modes.description: The digit after 18 inside a life-span date for a historical person.
modes.example: William Wordsworth (7 April 1770 – 23 April 18<<5>>0) was a major English Romantic poet

modes.label: Publication years
modes.description: The digit after 18 in a year given for a book or event.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about the nineteenth century, Victorian or Qing-era history, and away from unrelated code terms.
card.plain: It fires on the decade digit of a 1800s year, usually in a biography date.
